artifacts: repository training/inference code and split/result artifacts
note: README.md and Atlas paper 282 identify the public IXI structural-MRI dataset as the study data source and externally hosted pretrained models. The pinned repository provides code and supporting artifacts, but Stage 2 does not infer that the IXI corpus or all weights are bundled.

The pinned repository contains cardiac geometry models, fiber geometry, echo inputs, PAK/PAKT simulation-support files, executables, and visualization artifacts. These support the finite-element workflow and are not treated as a standalone PINN dataset.

The pinned WGImplicit repository contains the classical WG elastoplasticity Python source and license/README only; no reusable research dataset is bundled. Paper 539 uses this model to generate synthetic data, but the separate neural-network repository is not part of CR000172.
